{{Quote|We were on a routine patrol and ran into one of your rebel friends, a Lasat mercenary who worked for Saw Gerrera. I… was lucky, knocked out by the first blast. I came to, but found I couldn't move. And then I saw… him, the Lasat, calmly walk through smoke and fire to finish my unit off, one by one. The injured never had a chance. Always wondered why he let me live.|Alexsandr Kallus, to Garazeb Orrelios|<ref name="The Honorable Ones" />}}
A [[Lasat]] '''mercenary''' worked for [[Saw Gerrera]] and his [[Partisans]] during their [[Onderon insurgency|campaigns]] on the [[planet]] [[Onderon]]<ref name="The Honorable Ones" /> around [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> A [[Alexsandr Kallus' squad|squad]] of [[Galactic Empire|Imperials]], including [[Alexsandr Kallus]], was sent to Onderon to deal with the rebels. This [[mercenary]] [[Death|killed]] most of the unit, but spared Kallus. Kallus, while an [[agent]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], later recounted the story of his encounter with this mercenary to another Lasat rebel named [[Garazeb Orrelios]].<ref name="The Honorable Ones" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[2017]] novel ''[[Rebel Rising]]'', a Lasat is seen on [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Wrea]] [[Saw Gerrera's Wrea outpost|outpost]]. When the author [[Beth Revis]] was asked if the Lasat in Saw's base and the one that Kallus encountered were the same, the author answered that in her mind it was supposed to be.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|bethrevis|status/861660974176141312|[[Beth Revis]]|quote=In my mind, yes.|archivefile=File:RevisAnswerasat.jpg|nolive=1}}</ref> The Lasat's actions on Onderon were dated to [[7 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'',<ref name="The Visual">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> while ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dated the event to circa [[18 BBY]]. ''Timelines'' also dates Kallus's appearance in "[[Flight of the Falcon, Part 1: Spy Games]]," in which Kallus is seen carrying out an Imperial mission, to circa [[10 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines" /> As his deployment to Onderon is supposed to be Kallus's first Imperial mission according to ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''<ref name="Ultimate New">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> and ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'',<ref name="Comp Ency">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> the Lasat's attack cannot occur in 7 BBY, per Kallus's mission in "Spy Games."
